title: Preview
failed: The file could not be read.

tooLarge.title: Too large to show here
tooLarge.body: This viewer reads files up to {{limit}}. You can still look at its bytes, which are read by pages.

image.brokenBody: The file is damaged, truncated, too large to decode, or in a format the browser does not draw.
image.noMetadata: No camera metadata in this file.

media.unsupported: This browser cannot play this file
media.unsupportedBody: Its format or codec is not one the browser plays. Download it to play it on your computer.

pdf.label: Document {{name}}
pdf.brokenBody: The file is damaged or is not a PDF the viewer can read.
pdf.passwordTitle: This PDF is protected with a password
pdf.passwordBody: Type its password to open it. The password stays inside the viewer: it is not sent anywhere and is forgotten when the viewer closes.
pdf.wrongPassword: That password is not right. Try again.

archive.failed: The archive could not be listed.
archive.entryFailed: This entry could not be read.
archive.entryTooLarge: The viewer opens entries up to {{limit}}. Download it to open it on your computer.
archive.truncated: Only the first {{count}} entries are listed
archive.label: Contents of {{name}}
archive.unsafeHint: Extracted as it is, this name would land outside the folder or at a place of its own. Transferly never extracts it.
archive.bombHint: It claims to grow more than 200 times once extracted, which no real file does. The server refuses to extract it.
archive.localUnsupported: The browser cannot open this archive
archive.localUnsupportedBody: It reads ZIP, TAR and gzip archives of your computer. Open 7z, RAR, bzip2, xz and zstd archives from a server, which reads them all.

office.label: Document {{name}}
office.protected: This document is protected with a password
office.protectedBody: Transferly does not open protected documents. Download it to open it with its password.
office.brokenBody: The file is damaged or is not a document the viewer can read.

noViewer.title: No viewer for this kind of file
noViewer.body: Transferly cannot show this file inside the platform. Download it to open it on your computer.

sqlite.label: Database {{name}}
sqlite.brokenBody: The file is damaged or is not a SQLite database.

font.label: Font {{name}}
font.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789
font.charactersUnknown: Basic Latin and Latin-1 characters (this format does not tell which it has)
font.brokenBody: The file is damaged or is not a font the browser can read.

certificate.subject: Subject
certificate.privateKeyBody: Transferly never shows private keys. Anyone who has this file can use the key: keep it out of shared folders.
certificate.unreadableBody: It is damaged, or of a kind the viewer does not read.

mail.label: Message {{name}}
mail.remote: Remote images and content of this message were not loaded.
mail.brokenBody: The file is damaged or is not an email message.
